text:
Sam (Finance): VertexGrid invoice arrived but PO number in their PDF doesn't match our PO. Invoice VG-4520 for $6,300. Header shows PO: PO-2026-77 (we don't have that). Can AP look?

invoices-bot: Auto-check: NO_PO_MATCH for invoice VG-4520. Reason: vendor_po_format_mismatch. Suggested action: request vendor to provide our PO or escalate to procurement.

Luis (AP): Can you upload the PDF or paste header? I'll try a fuzzy match.

Sam (Finance): PDF: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/VG-4520.pdf
Header snippet:
```
Vendor: VertexGrid LLC
Invoice #: VG-4520
Date: 2026-12-05
Total: $6,300.00
PO Ref: PO-2026-77
Remit: billing@vertexgrid.com
```
Vendor note: "Applied vendor credit: CN-117 (applies to prior invoice)."

Ella (Accounting): We have a PO 2026-77 but that's for a different vendor (EdgeCompute) — looks like vendor used internal partner PO number.

Luis (AP): I tried manual attach to PO 2026-77 and system rejected: "vendor mismatch: vendor on PO is EdgeCompute, invoice vendor VertexGrid". Holding payment.

VertexGrid Billing: Hi team — sorry for the mix-up. Our billing batch incorrectly inserted partner PO. We did apply credit note CN-117 to your account on 2026-11-20. Transaction ID: CR-9901. We can re-issue invoice without PO or send a corrected invoice referencing your PO 9033 if you provide it.

Sam (Finance): Thanks. We don't see CR-9901 in our bank feed. @Luis please hold. Can procurement confirm whether PO 9033 exists and if VertexGrid is approved supplier?

Ana (Procurement): VertexGrid is an approved services vendor, PO 9033 exists and is open for "model-training credits" (cost center ml-costs). PO 9033 total remaining $10k. But PO 9033 was created under cost center ml-research, which currently maps to approver group research-leads. Our approver mapping recently changed and invoice routing is failing.

invoices-bot: Routing error: cost_center_map_missing for cost center "ml-research". Contact procurement to remap or use /costcenter update.

Luis (AP): I can update the invoice cost center to ml-costs which has an approver (team-ml). Doing the change now.

Ella (Accounting): Updated cost center to ml-costs on the invoice record. Trying attach to PO 9033.

invoices-bot: Manual attach OK. Invoice VG-4520 attached to PO 9033. Routing to approver group team-ml. Status: Pending approval.

VertexGrid Billing: We'll hold on re-issuing. Please confirm if you want a corrected invoice without the partner PO or we can resend with PO 9033.

Sam (Finance): Please resend corrected invoice referencing PO 9033 and include credit CN-117 with CR-9901 attached, so AP can reconcile. Also send refund/credit proof if CN already posted.

Luis (AP): Created ticket FIN-9621 to reconcile credit CN-117 and match bank TXN if present. Payment on hold until credit reconciled and approver approves.

Ana (Procurement): I'll check approver mapping for ml-research and follow up if needed. Expect update in 24h. :white_check_mark:
